notes: Seeded from a research pass on 12 Oct 2026. Every listing URL was tested with scripts/page_text.py (which obeys robots.txt and the never-use list); 'readable' records the result: ok, js-only, refused or failed.

This scout covers dated special events only: supper clubs, pop-ups and residencies, guest-chef nights, dated special menus, tastings, food festivals, special market editions, cookery classes, openings and launch parties, taproom events, quizzes with food. Ordinary opening hours and weekly markets are 'On repeat' material, not events.

Most E2 restaurants and bars announce events only on Instagram, which agents never fetch. Venues with no_primary_listing: true need a direct relationship (an email list, a shared calendar or reader tips) before the scout can list them. Without a primary page the verifier may publish them on aggregator evidence only at medium confidence at most.
Many venue pages print dates without a year (e.g. 'Thursday 1st October'). Check the weekday matches the year before writing a date.
Status evidence for a few venues rests on page metadata or footers (Rochelle Canteen, Town Hall Hotel). The venue profiler should confirm them on its first run.
Netil Market, Hackney Brewery and Five Points could not be fetched because the research sandbox's proxy blocked them. That says nothing about the sites; retest from the routine environment.
Scouts may read this file but must not edit it. Suggested changes go in the run report for a person to apply.

Platform 'domains' are enforced by scripts/validate.py and scripts/check_quote.py: do-not-use and do-not-scrape domains are never fetched or accepted as evidence; discovery-only domains can never be labelled primary.

zones.core: E2 postcode or within about 1km of Bethnal Green tube (Paradise Row, Cambridge Heath Rd, Bethnal Green Rd, Columbia Rd, Hackney Rd east end, Victoria Park west edge). Scanned every run.
zones.fringe: Up to about a 20-minute walk (1.6km) from Bethnal Green tube: Arnold Circus/Calvert Ave, Broadway Market, Netil/London Fields, Brick Lane, Spitalfields edge, Haggerston, Mile End. Scanned every run.
zones.outer: Further out (Dalston, Hackney Wick, Clapton, Walthamstow, Shoreditch west). Scanned weekly, standout food and drink events only, max 5 candidates per run, flagged worth_the_trip.

platforms.name: Resident Advisor (ra.co)
platforms.why: No public API. Terms 4.4 ban automated extraction without written permission; robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot. Do not fetch, do not use third-party RA scrapers.

platforms.name: Ticket Tailor
platforms.how: Read public box-office pages (tickettailor.com/events/<box-office>) one at a time. Common for supper clubs and pop-ups. No E2 food box office confirmed yet; add box-office URLs to venues as they are found.

platforms.name: DICE
platforms.how: Read public dice.fm event pages one at a time; occasionally used for food parties and tasting events. Check robots.txt each run.

platforms.name: Eventbrite
platforms.how: Location search API was shut off in 2020; list events by organiser or venue id only (env EVENTBRITE_TOKEN). The public browse page https://www.eventbrite.com/b/united-kingdom--london--bethnal-green/food-and-drink/food/ was readable (ok) on 12 Oct 2026 but mixes in far-away events (Alexandra Palace, Barking) — use it for leads only and confirm the venue address.

platforms.name: DesignMyNight
platforms.how: Leads only. Venue pages show dated ticketed events (e.g. Renegade Wine Bar E2 tastings, readable ok on 12 Oct 2026). Confirm on the venue's own page where one exists.

platforms.name: ma.to
platforms.how: Leads only. Carries dated Victoria Park Market Sunday listings with guest traders (readable ok). Confirm on a primary page where one exists.

platforms.name: Hot Dinners
platforms.how: Best source for openings, residencies and pop-ups. Read the Bethnal Green tag page (https://www.hot-dinners.com/component/tags/tag/bethnal-green, readable ok) weekly. Leads only; confirm dates on the venue or ticket page.

platforms.name: Time Out London
platforms.how: Monthly 'best new restaurants opening' news pages are readable (ok) with opening dates and addresses. Leads only.

platforms.name: Broadsheet London
platforms.how: Seasonal pop-ups and residencies round-ups, readable (ok), dated. Mostly outside E2; leads only.

platforms.name: London Cocktail Week
platforms.how: Bar pages and an events schedule (guest shifts, tastings, dinners) each October. On 12 Oct 2026 the events page still showed the 2025 look-back, so check again before each October. Leads only.

platforms.name: OpenTable
platforms.why: robots.txt disallows BethnalGreenLiveBot (page_text refused https://www.opentable.co.uk/r/brawn on 12 Oct 2026). OpenTable 'experiences' pages are therefore off-limits.

platforms.name: Resy
